description: Search the live directory of PTIRU-accredited (Private Training Institutions Regulatory Unit) private career colleges across British Columbia (e.g., Vancouver, Surrey, Burnaby, Richmond, Victoria, Kelowna). Use this tool when a user wants to verify whether a BC college is accredited or StudentAid BC designated. Returns up to 12 matching colleges with city, StudentAid designation status, PTIRU certification status, and direct profile URLs.

city.description: Optional BC city filter (case-insensitive substring match, e.g., 'Vancouver', 'Surrey', 'Burnaby', 'Richmond', 'Victoria', 'Kelowna').

keyword.description: Optional college name keyword (case-insensitive substring match, e.g., 'Sprott Shaw', 'CDI', 'Stenberg', 'Vancouver Career').

name: search_ptiru_colleges
title: Search PTIRU-Accredited BC Career Colleges
